text:
incident-bot: PAGER: high tail latency observed on /v1/generate (region: us-west1). Impact ~15% of requests, error rate spike to 4%. Paging on-call.

sara-oncall: I’m on it. seeing elevated p95 and p99 on the dashboard. pattern started ~17:42 UTC.

raj-runtime: throwing a quick look — logs show increased queuing on model-serving pool A, backlog growing every 30s. suspect KV cache eviction thrash after a rollout earlier. can we route traffic to pool B?

maria-sre: confirmed. pool A GPUs hitting 100% GPU mem occasionally, OOM-ish behavior, retries. no infra alerts for hosts themselves though.

sara-oncall: raj — can you fail traffic to pool B? use the manual route policy for this customer tier. I'll open a mitigation channel and update status.

raj-runtime: running command now: ```rbctl route set --service gen-api --from poolA --to poolB --weight 100 --reason "hotfix route due to queue thrash"```

ops-bot: change applied: routing gen-api -> poolB (100%). No failures in the change deployment.

tina-cs: any estimation on customer impact? a few customers pinged support about slow completions.

jordan-pm: logged customer reports: 3 customers with >30s completions during window, two are trial accounts but one is an enterprise account (acme-corp). need to surface to CS and ops.

sam-reliability: metrics look stabilizing post-route. p95 down to normal, error rate back under 0.5%. keep monitoring for 15m before closing page.

sara-oncall: monitoring. creating a short incident stub now and capturing initial notes. action: schedule postmortem. tagging eng-runtime + SRE.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-01. Severity: SEV2. Start: 2026-04-23T17:42:12Z. Links: https://redwoodops/incident/INC-2026-0423-01

maria-sre: quick RCA hypothesis: recent rollout to pool A included updated KV cache size and eviction heuristic. seems like the new heuristic caused frequent full-cache churn for long-conversation workloads, which leads to regen and queue pressure.

raj-runtime: pulled the rollout diff. there's a config change `kv.eviction_mode=aggressive` landing in that deploy. rolling back that flag on pool A is safer than full redeploy. proposing: revert config, monitor 30m, then re-evaluate canary.

sara-oncall: agree. raj — please do revert and post the command you ran. I'll keep the incident open and coordinate handoff to post-incident.

raj-runtime: revert command: ```rbctl set-config --pool poolA --kv.eviction_mode conservative && rbctl restart-service --pool poolA gen-runtime --grace 60``` applied at 17:58 UTC.

ops-bot: restart jobs queued. poolA hosts coming back healthy.

tina-cs: informing Acme account: "We experienced a latency incident impacting some requests; mitigation applied and performance restored. We will follow up with a post-incident summary and any action items."

jordan-pm: please add a note to the incident doc to include customer timeline and any possible billing/credit conversation.

sara-oncall: handing off to follow-up team. On-call coverage shifting in 30m; @maria-sre please take ownership of post-incident coordination. I'll leave my notes in the doc.

maria-sre: taking it. next steps: 1) schedule postmortem meeting (1h) 2) enumerate action items 3) size and prioritize (t-shirt + effort estimate) 4) assign owners and link to quarterly plan. anyone object to a postmortem at 2026-04-24 15:00 UTC?

sam-reliability: fine for me. prefer to include runtime + infra + customer success folks.

tina-cs: I’ll join; will add affected customers list.

raj-runtime: will join. initial action items I already see: roll back flag (done), add automatic anomaly detection for KV churn (new), add a safer deploy guard for config-only changes (new).

maria-sre: adding proposed action items (short bullets to be moved to tracker):
- Action A: Add anomaly alert for KV eviction rate and queue length spikes (owner: sam-reliability)
- Action B: Add deploy guard / preflight for config-only changes to eviction heuristics (owner: raj-runtime)
- Action C: Customer comms & credit assessment for Acme (owner: tina-cs)
- Action D: Post-deploy canary change to gate `kv.eviction_mode` across pools (owner: raj-runtime)

jordan-pm: size proposals (T-shirt + rough days):
- Action A: M (2-3d) — metric + alert + dashboard updates.
- Action B: L (5-8d) — build preflight checks + CI gating for config changes.
- Action C: S (1d) — CS comms + billing review.
- Action D: M (3d) — canary infra + rollout policy changes.

sam-reliability: agree with sizes. I’d break Action B into B1 (policy + docs, 2d) and B2 (CI preflight implementation, 3-5d) if that helps planning.

maria-sre: prioritization notes: since this caused customer-visible latency and affected an enterprise account, we mark B (deploy guard) and A (alerts) as P0 for the quarter. C is P1, D P1. We should aim to deliver A within the next sprint and B as a Q2 backend platform priority.

tina-cs: for CS — can we have a timeline by tomorrow EOD for comms and credit recommendation? I can escalate if needed.

raj-runtime: I'll draft a deploy guard plan today and post PR for B1. tagging the infra reviewers.

sara-oncall: thanks team. I’ll close the page once we have the postmortem scheduled and an owner assigned to each action item. leaving handoff note: event root cause suspected config change; mitigation was routing to poolB and revert; customers notified.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423-01 status: Mitigated. Page closed by sara-oncall at 18:04 UTC.

maria-sre: created postmortem doc: https://redwooddocs/postmortems/INC-2026-0423-01. I added the four actions with owners and sizes. Please comment if you disagree with priority/size.

sam-reliability: comment added on Action A — will scope the alert to include historical baseline comparison to reduce noise.

raj-runtime: PR out for B1 (docs + policy), link: https://git.redwood/rj/kv-deploy-guard/pull/12

tina-cs: CS comms draft posted in incident doc. recommended credit: 1 month trial extension for affected accounts, pending finance approval.

jordan-pm: aligning these actions with Q2 roadmap item infra-hardening. tagging product leadership for prioritization sync.

maria-sre: thanks — will set meeting for postmortem review tomorrow and capture final estimates then. closing thread for now but will update when actions move. :white_check_mark:
